# AROH Platform
> A premium unified digital ecosystem platform and open-source foundation connecting specialized digital applications with shared infrastructure, design tokens, identity, Aros ledger economy, and DPDP Act 2023 data-protection compliance.

## Overview
AROH is an open-source monorepo ecosystem platform designed to unite autonomous, specialized digital products under a shared architectural foundation. Rather than building isolated applications, AROH provides:
- **Central Platform Hub (`Aroh/`)**: Next.js 16 web portal, unified header, command palette, universal footer, cookie banner, and public discovery portals.
- **Platform SDK (`@aroh/asdk`)**: Shared TypeScript contracts, canonical product registry, in-memory auth fallback, token services, and DPDP privacy/consent engines.
- **Design System (`@aroh/ads`)**: Design tokens, typography variables (Outfit font), elevation styles, and motion language (Rise, Elevate, Flow, Expand, Illuminate).
- **Independent Spoke Products (`Products/`)**: Decoupled, autonomous applications (media streaming, logistics, planetary intelligence, developer tools) connected via explicit adapter contracts.

## Authoritative Endpoints
- Canonical Web Deployment: https://aroh-os.vercel.app
- Canonical Source Repository: https://github.com/Aroh-Open-Source/AROH
- Canonical Branch: `main`
- Full LLM Context Document: https://aroh-os.vercel.app/llms-full.txt

## Key Public Routes
- [Homepage](https://aroh-os.vercel.app/): Ecosystem hero, product highlights, and platform entry points.
- [Explore Products](https://aroh-os.vercel.app/explore): Interactive exploration catalog with capability filters.
- [Products Directory](https://aroh-os.vercel.app/products): Split-screen products launcher and verified directory.
- [Developer AI Studio](https://aroh-os.vercel.app/ai): Multi-provider AI orchestrator and stateless prompt workspace.
- [Terms of Service](https://aroh-os.vercel.app/terms): Platform usage terms and governance agreements.
- [Acceptable Use Policy](https://aroh-os.vercel.app/acceptable-use): Standards for acceptable ecosystem behavior.
- [Privacy Notice](https://aroh-os.vercel.app/privacy): Itemized statutory notice under DPDP Act 2023 Section 5.
- [Cookie Preferences & Policy](https://aroh-os.vercel.app/cookies): Detailed cookie inventory and granular preference controls.
- [Data Principal Rights Portal](https://aroh-os.vercel.app/privacy/rights): Chapter III statutory rights workflow (Access, Correction, Erasure, Nomination).
- [Grievance Redressal](https://aroh-os.vercel.app/privacy/grievance): Section 13 grievance submission and tracking portal.
- [Data Retention Schedule](https://aroh-os.vercel.app/privacy/retention): Purpose-specific data retention horizons and auto-deletion protocols.
- [AI Privacy Notice](https://aroh-os.vercel.app/privacy/ai): Stateless execution guarantee (zero customer data used for model training).
- [Security Safeguards](https://aroh-os.vercel.app/privacy/security): Encryption standards and 9-stage incident response framework.

## Registered Ecosystem Products
All products are verified from canonical source repositories and live deployments:

- **OmniStream** (`/explore/omnistream`): Personal media experience platform uniting ad-free video discovery (U-TUBE) with cinematic fixed-aperture theater (CineMorph) and browser-native edge intelligence (OMS).
  - Version: v1.8.5
  - Live: https://0mnistream.vercel.app/
  - Repo: https://github.com/UdayPatnala/OmniStream

- **SpeDex** (`/explore/spedex`): Intelligent courier delivery and logistics platform featuring real-time package tracking, multi-stop route optimization, and driver telemetry.
  - Version: v2.1.0
  - Live: https://spedex.vercel.app/
  - Repo: https://github.com/UdayPatnala/SpeDex

- **Nebula** (`/explore/nebula`): Planetary intelligence dashboard delivering live telemetry from Earth and space (ISS orbital tracking, seismic events, orbital rocket countdowns, NASA imagery).
  - Version: v1.4.2
  - Live: https://nebula-tau-nine.vercel.app/
  - Repo: https://github.com/UdayPatnala/nebula

- **Music Mirror** (`/explore/music-mirror`): Spotify playback synchronization engine featuring real-time audio analysis, dynamic visualizers, and lyric tracking.
  - Version: v1.2.0
  - Live: https://music-mirror.vercel.app/
  - Repo: https://github.com/UdayPatnala/Music-Mirror

- **JavaPath Pro** (`/explore/javapath-pro`): Interactive Java learning and JVM engineering platform with in-browser coding playgrounds and structured certification tracks.
  - Version: v1.1.0
  - Live: https://javapath-pro.vercel.app/
  - Repo: https://github.com/UdayPatnala/javapath-pro

- **Aros Wallet & Ledger Engine** (`/explore/aros-wallet`): Internal platform utility credits economy supporting secure balance transfers and membership tiers.
  - Category: Platform Utility
  - Status: Internal Core Service

- **AROH CMS Alerts Engine** (`/explore/aroh-cms`): Scheduled ecosystem announcements, push notifications, and markdown broadcast management.
  - Category: Platform Utility
  - Status: Internal Core Service

- **Aros Metrics Engine** (`/explore/aros-metrics`): Real-time operational telemetry, ledger performance charts, and distributed session monitoring.
  - Category: Platform Utility
  - Status: Internal Core Service

## Governance & Privacy Compliance
AROH is engineered to support compliance with the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 (DPDP Act) and the Digital Personal Data Protection Rules, 2025:
- Clear affirmative consent standards (DPDP Act Section 6).
- 1-click consent withdrawal parity (DPDP Act Section 6(4)).
- Dedicated Data Principal Rights submission workflows (DPDP Act Chapter III).
- Timed grievance redressal with statutory tracking (DPDP Act Section 13).
- Strict purpose-based retention and cascading account erasure (DPDP Act Sections 8(7) & 12).
- Zero fabrication: Legal entities and designated officers use standard placeholders pending external legal review (`LEGAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED`).
